item.title: Gubernatorial Forum takes place in Chamblee while Trump is in Rome
item.description: At a Democratic Gubernatorial forum in Chamblee, GA, seven candidates discussed topics ranging from education and healthcare reform to ICE's presence in Georgia and the FBI raid on the Board of Elections office, while also addressing the presence of Donald Trump in the state. item.title: NASCAR’s Rajah Caruth gives back to his hometown
item.description: Atlanta-born NASCAR driver Rajah Caruth visited the Jesse Draper Boys and Girls Club to inspire middle schoolers with his journey in motorsports, emphasizing the importance of perseverance, resilience, and determination. The post NASCAR’s Rajah Caruth gives back to his hometown appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Amanda Free named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia
item.description: Amanda Free has been named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia, bringing with her over 20 years of experience in sales, operations, and consulting, and a commitment to improving the health and well-being of Georgia's communities. The post Amanda Free named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: “Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl’s Baseball Dream” is playing now
item.description: "Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl's Baseball Dream" is a musical production at Synchronicity Theatre that tells the true story of Marcenia "Toni Stone" Lyle, the first woman to play professional baseball in the Negro Leagues. The post “Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl’s Baseball Dream” is playing now appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Trump announces global tariffs will increase to 15% from 10% ‘effective immediately’
item.description: President Donald Trump has increased the global tariffs he imposed a day earlier to 15% from 10% following an adverse ruling at the Supreme Court, which ruled that he exceeded his authority with the way he imposed tariffs on trading partners using the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA). The post Trump announces global tariffs will increase to 15% from 10% ‘effective immediately’ appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta
item.description: Le Nouveau Maquis, a West African restaurant, is opening a second location in Tucker, while Cuevacía, a Northern Mexico-inspired restaurant, has opened in Midtown, and Heritage, a restaurant focusing on the cuisines of Black and brown people, is set to open in Summerhill. The post Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘It’s an assignment and not just an opportunity’: Morehouse hires new head football coach
item.description: Morehouse College introduced Brad Sherrod as their new head football coach, who will bring his 30-year coaching experience to the program and lead with integrity, enthusiasm, mental and physical toughness, caring and selfishness, and great effort. The post ‘It’s an assignment and not just an opportunity’: Morehouse hires new head football coach appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘We’ve got it all’: State of Fulton County is a big deal, says Pitts
item.description: Fulton County Chair Robb Pitts addressed the State of the County at The Eastern, discussing the county's triple-A credit rating, low unemployment rate, and progress in healthcare, human services, and mental health care services, while also addressing the recent FBI raid and potential ICE implications. The post ‘We’ve got it all’: State of Fulton County is a big deal, says Pitts appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Building a better tomorrow’: The Arena at Southlake arrives in March
item.description: The Arena at Southlake, a $117 million, 268,000-square-foot facility, is set to open in March 2026, providing a premier venue for concerts, sporting events, and community gatherings, as well as educational opportunities for students in Clayton County. The post ‘Building a better tomorrow’: The Arena at Southlake arrives in March appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
